items.title: David Tepper and 25 Other Big Funds Bought Applied Materials Last Quarter, While 27 Sold. Who’s Right?
items.summary: Key TakeawaysOf the 460 big funds that have filed 13Fs for the third quarter, 26 bought Applied Materials, including David Tepper’s Appaloosa, and 27 sold, including Brad Gerstner’s Altimeter. The selling went beyond Applied: Altimeter also sold all of its KLA shares, and 11 of the sellers added Intel in the same quarter.
